events.title: Russian Drone Strike Collapses Apartment Block In Kyiv Region
events.summary: A Russian drone struck a five-storey apartment building in Dymer, Kyiv Oblast, on 22 November, partly collapsing it. Officials initially said up to 15 people were unaccounted for, and rescuers searched the rubble into 23 November. By 23 November the death toll had risen to 11. The toll may change as the search continues.

events.title: Russian Double-Tap Strike On Kryvyi Rih Kills A Boy And A Paramedic
events.summary: Two Russian ballistic missiles struck near a restaurant in central Kryvyi Rih on the evening of 20 November, and drones then hit the area as emergency crews responded, said Oleksandr Vilkul, head of the city's defence council. A 20-year-old paramedic was killed at the scene and a seven-year-old boy later died in hospital. Officials gave differing injury figures, from 52 to 60. President Zelensky said on 21 November that Russia was increasing its use of repeat strikes on rescuers.

events.title: Russian Strikes Hit Three Kyiv Bridges And Two European Embassies
events.summary: Russia launched a large overnight missile and drone attack on Ukraine on 20 November, after President Vladimir Putin threatened a response to Ukraine's strikes on the Crimean Bridge. Kyiv mayor Vitali Klitschko said the Podilsko-Voskresenskyi, Southern and Darnytskyi bridges were damaged. Ukraine's prime minister said eight people were killed, six in Kyiv and two at a railway station in Lviv; Russia said it targeted bridges used to move military equipment. On 19 November a drone raid on Kyiv had damaged the Dutch and Austrian embassies and St Volodymyr's Cathedral.

events.title: Russian Strikes On Central Odesa Kill Four
events.summary: Russian strikes hit the centre of Odesa in three waves on 18 November, killing four people and injuring at least 13, according to officials including regional governor Oleh Kiper. President Zelensky said strikes continued after first responders had arrived at the scene.

events.title: Ukrainian Strikes Collapse A Section Of The Crimean Bridge
events.summary: Ukrainian forces struck the Kerch Strait (Crimean) Bridge on 16 and 17 November; Ukraine's General Staff said an arch and a span of the road section collapsed, and the Security Service of Ukraine said no vehicles could cross it. President Zelensky said the seven-stage operation used Palianytsia drones on the road section and Neptune missiles with Ruta and FP-5 drones on the railway section. Neptune missiles hit the railway section again overnight on 19 November and train services were suspended, while Russian President Vladimir Putin vowed to rebuild the bridge and threatened a response.

events.title: Zelensky Says US Raised NATO Membership In Exchange For Donbas Withdrawal
events.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky told journalists, in remarks reported on 14 November, that US negotiators had asked whether Ukraine would withdraw its forces from the part of Donbas it still controls if it were offered NATO membership. He said it was the first time the question had been raised. The account is Zelensky's; the remarks follow the Abu Dhabi talks that ended on 11 November.

events.title: Russian Strikes On Energy Facilities Cut Power To Tens Of Thousands In Odesa Region
events.summary: Russian strikes on energy facilities of the private company DTEK in Odesa Oblast left almost 50,000 households without electricity on 14 November, and a further attack on the north of the region on 16 November cut power to 52,200 households. Ukraine's First Deputy Energy Minister Artem Nekrasov said Russian forces attacked the country's energy and oil and gas sectors 116 times between 9 and 15 November.

events.title: Russia Strikes Kyiv With Ballistic Missiles Hours After Peace Talks End
events.summary: Russia attacked Kyiv with ballistic missiles and drones overnight into 12 November, hours after peace talks ended. Kyiv mayor Vitali Klitschko said one person was killed and eight were injured; a drone hit a nine-storey apartment block in the Solomianskyi district. On 11 November two State Emergency Service firefighters were killed by a repeat Russian strike while putting out a fire in Yahotyn, Kyiv Oblast.

events.title: Hackers Deface Website Of State News Agency Ukrinform
events.summary: Hackers replaced the homepage of Ukraine's state news agency Ukrinform on 11 November with the word ZELENET, an image of a crossed-out Ukrainian flag and a link to a Telegram channel, and renamed the agency's X account. Director General Serhii Cherevatyi said the agency was working with the Security Service of Ukraine and the State Service of Special Communications and Information Protection to deal with the consequences.

events.title: Russian Strikes On Six Substations Cause Outages Across Ukraine
events.summary: Russia attacked six major power substations in Vinnytsia, Kirovohrad, Zhytomyr and Cherkasy oblasts overnight into 11 November, causing power outages across Ukraine, Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi said. He said power lines were also damaged in Kirovohrad and Rivne oblasts.

events.title: Russian Drone Strike On Chornomorsk Market Kills Four
events.summary: A Russian jet-powered drone struck a market in central Chornomorsk, Odesa Oblast, on 11 November, killing four people and injuring at least eight, Odesa regional governor Oleh Kiper said. The Ukrainian Air Force had warned shortly before that a jet-powered drone was heading towards the city. Kiper said the blast also damaged nearby residential buildings and cars.

events.title: Abu Dhabi Talks End With Large Prisoner Exchange Agreed
events.summary: Two days of US-mediated talks between Ukrainian and Russian delegations in Abu Dhabi ended on 11 November with agreement on a large-scale prisoner exchange but no breakthrough on ending the war. Ukraine's chief negotiator Rustem Umerov and Russia's Vladimir Medinsky both confirmed the planned exchange. US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner said they would travel to Moscow to meet President Vladimir Putin and then to Dublin to meet President Volodymyr Zelensky.

events.title: Russian Strike On Aid Point Kills Dozens In Zaporizhzhia Region
events.summary: Russian aerial bombs struck a school building used as a shelter and humanitarian aid hub in the village of Komyshuvakha, in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, on 2 November. President Volodymyr Zelensky said Russia dropped at least nine bombs on the building and called it one of the deadliest attacks of the war. By 7 November, Ukrainian authorities said the death toll had risen to 55.

events.title: Drone Strike On Dnipro Railway Station Kills At Least 14
events.summary: A Russian drone strike on a busy platform at Dnipro's main railway station on 29 October killed at least 14 people, Ukrainian officials said. Russian attacks across Ukraine killed at least 19 people that day. The strike drew outrage in Europe.

events.title: Russian Strike On Central Chernihiv Kills Two Teenage Girls
events.summary: A daytime Russian strike on central Chernihiv on 29 October killed two 15-year-old girls and injured 31 people, including a baby, according to Ukrainian officials. The city's mayor said a Banderol drone-launched cruise missile hit the crowded city centre.
